entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Mixing Views into Table-Per-Concrete-Type #37203
  • Could not load file or assembly 'System.Runtime, Version 10.0.0.0 #37201
  • ComplexType projection causes buggy SQL #37199

Closed

  • `ExecuteUpdateAsync` triggers `IL2037: No members were resolved for ...` #37192
    11.0.0
  • EF Core 10 throws System.DivideByZeroException if number of parameters are between 2070 and 2100 #37151
    10.0.1
  • Unexpected behavior for non-optional complex type where all properties are nullable #37162
    10.0.1
  • System.Version with Like query #37202
  • [EF CORE 10] migrate from .NET9, error ManyServiceProvidersCreatedWarning #37191
  • Incorrect logic in 10.0 parameter deduplication step #37189
    10.0.1
  • Feature Request: Support for OrderByRaw() or raw SQL ORDER BY expressions in LINQ #37187
  • ComplexCollection how to configure HasMaxLength etc for the properties? #37140

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37200

Merged

  • Correct [DynamicDependency] reference on ExecuteUpdateAsync #37194
  • [release/10.0] Fix bucketization for number of values between 2070 and 2100 for SQL Server. #37198
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.1
  • [release/10.0.1] Fix materialization of non-nullable complex type with all-null properties #37196
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.1
  • Fix bucketization for number of values between 2070 and 2100 for SQL Server. #37197
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #37164
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37148

Updated

  • Fix flaky test by creating proper race condition between HandleTransactionCompleted and ClearTransactions #37101
